theorem.R_p_l: Unoccupied TRUE physical cells in original K4 line l if no cell already opponent-(1-p)-owned; otherwise blocked/null
theorem.f_p_l: One iff R_p_l is exactly one physical missing cell v and v is the currently playable gravity landing in its column; otherwise zero

theorem.sameOwnerLegalNonterminalMoveX: f_p_l(new)-f_p_l(old) = +1[y exists and R_p_l={y}] +1[R_p_l={x,v} for original K4 two-missing surviving requirement AND v belongs to the genuinely legal next-frontier F_after]
theorem.whoMoves: m=occupied rank n mod2; formulas hold for BOTH p=0 and p=1 based on m equals p or differs
theorem.eventOrdering: if any move itself produces an original four-cell firstwin, game absorbs terminal BEFORE any following action; formulas are nonterminal transfer only
theorem.roleSpecificInterpretation: Opponent action sinks existing one-missing defender threats and can expose latent upper threat. Owner action may expose existing latent threat or promote TWO missing cell source to one missing cell threat. Both are real bounded causal transitions, not quantum unitary superposition.
theorem.providerRequirements: All 69 line-labelled owner residuals and actual gravity heights; threat vector alone not Markov/closed because promotion requires degree-2 and latent residual inputs
